purpose: Canonical versioned standard for experiment metrics, benchmark validity gates, evidence requirements, evaluation order, and run-result structure.

research_dimensions.autonomy: How often Claude asks the human and how much corrective supervision is required.
research_dimensions.cost: Token/resource usage and provider-reported monetary cost.
research_dimensions.quality: Correctness, architecture/instruction reliability, maintainability and flexibility.

result_report_contract.manifest_reference: Each run result records manifest path/version/SHA.
result_report_contract.embedded_dictionary: Run result embeds metricsdictionary for readability, but this manifest remains canonical.
result_report_contract.isolation_evidence: A benchmark run result must reference the preflight isolation evidence and protocol version/hash.

attempt_contract.purpose: Preserve immutable first-pass and every corrective attempt so immediate success cannot be conflated with success reached after repair.
attempt_contract.attempt_index: 0 is the initial task attempt; 1..N are corrective attempts.
attempt_contract.immutability_rule: attempt[0] is frozen when first-pass verification completes. Later corrective attempts must not overwrite first-pass values/evidence.

criticality.P0_BLOCKER: Failure rejects/invalidates the relevant result and short-circuits expensive downstream review.
criticality.P1_CRITICAL: Serious quality failure; reject or refactor before treating as positive.
criticality.P2_MAJOR: Material degradation; continue cheap/automatic checks but it affects comparison.
criticality.P3_MINOR: Secondary trade-off; do not reject on this metric alone.

evaluation_stages.name: benchmark_preflight
evaluation_stages.purpose: Verify model-visible workspace isolation and frozen run inputs before Claude starts.

evaluation_stages.name: capture_raw_run_facts
evaluation_stages.purpose: Always capture speed/autonomy/cost/raw artifacts even if later rejected.

evaluation_stages.name: automated_deep_quality
evaluation_stages.purpose: Architecture, ownership, references, loading and stale-reference checks.

evaluation_stages.name: human_and_hybrid_quality_review
evaluation_stages.purpose: Corrective interventions, decision-control violations and failure diagnosis.

evaluation_stages.name: maintenance_flexibility_and_efficiency
evaluation_stages.purpose: Placement, replacement blast radius, findability and secondary overhead.

early_stop_policy.on_p0_failure: Preserve evidence and mark rejected/invalid; skip expensive optional downstream checks and record every skipped check.
early_stop_policy.preflight_failure: A failed benchmark-isolation preflight invalidates the run before model execution. Do not collect benchmark performance from that run.

evidence_schema.rule: Every computed metric value must have enough evidence to re-check it without trusting the generator. Every skipped, not-applicable, or technically unavailable check must also carry evidence for that disposition.

failure_taxonomy.L: Loading — policy exists but did not reach context.
failure_taxonomy.E: Enforcement — deterministic guard should have caught the problem but did not.

aggregation.boolean_metrics: report rate and retain every run
aggregation.continuous_counts: report median, IQR, min, max and retain every run
aggregation.failed_runs: never discard or cherry-pick; invalid isolation runs are preserved but excluded from candidate-quality aggregates

metricsdictionary.purpose: Self-documenting dictionary for every metric that may appear in this report.
metricsdictionary.source_of_truth_rule: Metric definitions are frozen before benchmarking. Per-run values are derived from preserved evidence. LLM judgment is not primary ground truth.

field_dictionary.name: Machine-friendly metric name.
field_dictionary.kind: Top-level research dimension: speed, autonomy, cost, or quality.
field_dictionary.criticality: Severity of a bad Quality/validity result. Null for Speed, Autonomy, and Cost metrics.
field_dictionary.evaluation_stage: Order in the evaluation pipeline; not the same as criticality.
field_dictionary.collection_mode: AUTO, HUMAN, HYBRID, or a derived variant.
field_dictionary.preferred_direction: Whether higher, lower, true, or context-dependent values are preferable.
field_dictionary.research_role: Gate, primary outcome, supporting metric, or diagnostic.
field_dictionary.derived_from: Metric IDs used as inputs when the metric is derived.
field_dictionary.failure_effect: How a bad result affects evaluation flow or interpretation.
field_dictionary.evidence_required: Whether every per-run value must include evidence.
field_dictionary.measurement_scope: Lifecycle/protocol surface on which the metric is measured, e.g. benchmark_run, candidate_validation, trigger_probe, replacement_scenario.
field_dictionary.deprecated: Optional flag indicating a metric retained only for backward traceability.
field_dictionary.replaced_by: Optional metric IDs that supersede a deprecated metric.

entries.name: wall_clock_duration_seconds
entries.description: Elapsed benchmark execution time from initial task start through final evaluation, including all allowed corrective attempts.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Primary speed metric. Compares how long each instruction architecture takes to complete an equivalent task.
entries.notes: Includes corrective-attempt execution/evaluation time. SPD-003 reports the corrective-attempt portion separately.

entries.name: time_to_first_edit_seconds
entries.description: Time from run start to the first project-changing edit.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Diagnostic signal for planning/navigation overhead before useful work begins.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: recovery_duration_seconds
entries.description: Total execution/evaluation time spent in corrective attempts after the first-pass snapshot.
entries.applicability: All benchmark runs; zero when no corrective attempt occurs.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality; quantifies the time cost of recovery separately from total duration.
entries.benefit_for_research: Shows how much of a run's elapsed execution is consumed by repairing an initially incorrect result.
entries.notes: Summed per-attempt durations avoid counting arbitrary human idle time between evaluation and the next corrective prompt.

entries.name: user_questions_total
entries.description: Total number of explicit questions Claude asked the user after the initial benchmark prompt.
entries.formula: count(transcript events classified as direct user questions after initial prompt)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median and total across repetitions; retain every per-run value
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Primary autonomy metric requested by the researcher: how often Claude interrupts the human.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: legitimate_decision_request_count
entries.description: Questions that were required by the frozen decision policy.
entries.formula: count(question where decision rubric says approval_required=true)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median and total across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Prevents correct escalation from being misinterpreted as poor autonomy.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: invalid_decision_request_count
entries.description: Questions that should have been delegated to Claude under the frozen policy.
entries.formula: count(question where decision rubric says approval_required=false and clarification_not_needed)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median and total across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Detects over-cautious candidates that preserve correctness by constantly asking the human.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: corrective_intervention_count
entries.description: Number of user interventions made to correct Claude's mistake rather than answer a legitimate decision request.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median and total across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures how much active supervision the candidate needs to reach a correct result.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: weighted_intervention_score
entries.description: Severity-weighted total of corrective interventions using the frozen 1/2/3/5 rubric.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Diagnostic severity view of corrective interventions using the older 1/2/3/5 coding rubric. The frozen operator-burden outcome is AUT-010.
entries.notes: Do not substitute this score for AUT-010. AUT-005 codes intervention severity after human review; AUT-010 applies the protocol-fixed 1 point per question and 10 points per corrective prompt.

entries.name: corrective_supervision_free_success
entries.description: Run succeeds with no corrective human intervention and no unrequested architectural decision; legitimate questions may still have occurred.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true runs / all runs
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Separates successful work that required no corrective supervision from truly unattended execution.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: necessary_clarification_question_count
entries.description: Questions that were necessary because the task/input was genuinely ambiguous but did not represent a Reserved architectural decision.
entries.applicability: All benchmark runs.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality; explains why user_questions_total is non-zero.
entries.benefit_for_research: Makes the question taxonomy exhaustive enough to reconcile with user_questions_total.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: fully_unattended_success
entries.description: Run succeeds without any user response after the initial benchmark prompt.
entries.applicability: Benchmark runs intended to permit unattended completion.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality; represents an autonomy trade-off.
entries.benefit_for_research: Direct measure of literal unattended operation, distinct from correction-free success.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: corrective_prompt_count
entries.description: Number of standardized corrective prompts submitted after failed first-pass or corrective verification.
entries.applicability: All benchmark runs; zero when the first pass requires no corrective prompt.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max and total across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself; it increases operator burden and measured recovery cost/time.
entries.benefit_for_research: Directly distinguishes immediate success from solutions that require repeated human-initiated correction rounds.
entries.notes: A standardized corrective prompt also remains eligible for AUT-004/AUT-005 intervention coding, but AUT-009 counts rounds without subjective severity weighting.

entries.name: operator_penalty_points
entries.description: Protocol-fixed human/operator burden score: one point per Claude question plus ten points per corrective prompt.
entries.applicability: All benchmark runs.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality; summarizes human attention/repair burden as a frozen derived outcome.
entries.benefit_for_research: Implements the pre-candidate protocol penalty without mixing arbitrary points into physical wall-clock time.
entries.notes: Weights are frozen at question=1 and corrective_prompt=10 before candidate generation. Actual time, tokens, cost, and question classification remain separately reported.

entries.name: input_tokens
entries.description: Non-cache input tokens reported by runtime telemetry.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: One component of model usage cost and context consumption.
entries.notes: Run-level value includes initial plus all allowed corrective attempts. Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: output_tokens
entries.description: Output tokens reported by runtime telemetry.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Captures generated reasoning/action/output volume and contributes to billing.
entries.notes: Run-level value includes initial plus all allowed corrective attempts. Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: cache_read_input_tokens
entries.description: Cached input tokens read from prompt cache, if runtime telemetry exposes them.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Important because large reusable instruction contexts may be cheap to re-read but still affect processed context.
entries.notes: Run-level value includes initial plus all allowed corrective attempts. Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: cache_creation_input_tokens
entries.description: Input tokens written into prompt cache, if runtime telemetry exposes them.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Shows cache population overhead, relevant when candidates differ in static instruction corpus.
entries.notes: Run-level value includes initial plus all allowed corrective attempts. Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: total_processed_tokens
entries.description: Descriptive arithmetic sum of runtime token counters. It is not a billing-equivalent token count and is not used as the primary cost outcome.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Convenient descriptive volume signal while raw token categories and provider-reported cost remain authoritative.
entries.notes: Run-level value includes initial plus all allowed corrective attempts. Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: reported_cost_usd
entries.description: Cost reported directly by the runtime/provider. Null if unavailable; never reconstructed by an LLM.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions; total spend may also be reported
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Most direct monetary efficiency metric when provider telemetry exposes it.
entries.notes: Run-level value includes initial plus all allowed corrective attempts. Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: tool_calls
entries.description: Total structured tool invocations in the run.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Operational-overhead signal; useful for detecting indirection costs in more complex architectures.
entries.notes: Run-level value includes initial plus all allowed corrective attempts. Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: assistant_turns
entries.description: Assistant execution turns after the initial user prompt.
entries.formula: count(transcript assistant turns after initial prompt)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality by itself. Interpret as a trade-off; scenario-specific warning/abort ceilings may stop a run for resource control.
entries.benefit_for_research: Another operational-overhead signal that is less sensitive to network latency than wall-clock time.
entries.notes: Run-level value includes initial plus all allowed corrective attempts. Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: recovery_processed_tokens
entries.description: Descriptive token volume consumed by corrective attempts only; not a billing-equivalent token count.
entries.formula: sum(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens for corrective attempts)
entries.applicability: All benchmark runs; zero when no corrective attempt occurs.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Does not reject Quality; quantifies recovery resource usage.
entries.benefit_for_research: Makes the token cost of fixing an initially wrong result visible while total run cost still includes all attempts.
entries.notes: Per-attempt raw token categories remain authoritative. The arithmetic sum is descriptive only.

entries.name: evidence_completeness
entries.description: Whether all required run/evaluation artifacts are auditable: every computed metric has evidence and every skipped/unavailable check has evidence for its disposition.
entries.formula: all mandatory raw artifacts exist && every computed metric has >=1 evidence item && every skipped/not-applicable/technically-unavailable check has >=1 evidence item explaining disposition
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Validity gate: without raw evidence the run cannot be independently audited.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: candidate_structural_conformance
entries.description: Whether the generated candidate conforms to the structural predicates that define its intended experimental design.
entries.formula: candidate-specific structure checker has zero blocking predicate violations
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Validity gate: ensures a K1 result actually measures K1 rather than a leaked hybrid.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: build_passed
entries.description: Whether the externally executed build command completes successfully.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Hard correctness gate. A candidate that produces non-building code should not consume expensive downstream review time.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: mandatory_tests_passed
entries.description: Whether the frozen mandatory automated test suite completes with zero failures.
entries.formula: mandatory test suite has failed==0 and command exit_code==0
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Hard behavioral gate independent of Claude's own claim that tests pass.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: mandatory_acceptance_passed
entries.description: Whether every frozen mandatory acceptance criterion for the scenario passes.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Ensures the implementation satisfies the frozen task oracle, not merely compilation/tests.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: final_task_success
entries.description: Binary final run-level correctness outcome after the initial attempt and any allowed corrective attempts.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Primary run-level correctness outcome.
entries.notes: This is the final-after-recovery outcome. QLT-037 preserves whether the initial attempt already succeeded.

entries.name: acceptance_pass_rate
entries.description: Fraction of frozen mandatory acceptance criteria that pass in the run.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: More granular correctness metric than a binary task-success flag.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: architecture_violation_count
entries.description: Count of mechanically detectable violations of the intended application architecture after the task.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures whether the candidate keeps generated code inside the intended architecture.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: missing_policy_owner_count
entries.description: Count of inventory policies that have no authoritative normative owner in the generated candidate.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Detects V2 policy lost during candidate transformation.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: duplicate_policy_owner_count
entries.description: Count of inventory policies that have more than one authoritative normative owner in the generated candidate.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Direct SSoT metric; detects compensatory normative duplication and potential drift.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: broken_reference_count
entries.description: Count of unresolved instruction imports, routing references, manifests, or other candidate-internal references.
entries.formula: count(import/routing/manifest references whose target does not resolve)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures internal integrity of the instruction graph and prevents silent missing guidance.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: unrequested_architectural_decision_count
entries.description: Count of Reserved architectural decisions Claude made without the explicit approval required by the frozen decision policy.
entries.formula: count(Reserved decision made without explicit approval)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Tests whether the candidate prevents Claude from silently changing high-cost architectural choices.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: missed_required_decision_count
entries.description: Count of decisions for which the policy required user approval but Claude proceeded without requesting it.
entries.formula: count(event where rubric requires approval but Claude proceeded without request)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Complements unrequested-decision count and catches silent policy bypass.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: trigger_success_rate
entries.description: Fraction of expected instruction-loading triggers that produce the required observable probe behavior.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Directly tests whether relevant instructions reach Claude at the required moment.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: unexpected_trigger_count
entries.description: Count of instruction-loading probes that fire outside their intended scope or trigger.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Prevents 'load everything always' from looking good merely because required rules never miss.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: placement_accuracy
entries.description: Accuracy with which Claude places new instruction-system content into the oracle-defined owner/scope/loading role during maintenance scenarios.
entries.formula: correct placement decisions / expected placement decisions
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures whether the architecture helps Claude correctly maintain and extend the instruction system itself.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: external_capability_replacement_blast_radius
entries.description: Legacy replacement metric that counts authoritative artifacts changed outside a candidate-specific replacement boundary; retained only for backward traceability.
entries.formula: count(changed authoritative artifacts outside replaced module boundary)
entries.applicability: Capability-replacement scenarios; meaningful for all candidates, with module boundary interpreted per candidate definition.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Primary flexibility metric: quantifies how far a technology/architecture replacement leaks outside its module.
entries.notes: Deprecated because a generic 'outside module boundary' is not symmetrical for embedded candidates. Use QLT-035 for all candidates and QLT-036 only where a first-class replaceable module boundary exists.

entries.name: replacement_succeeded
entries.description: Whether a capability/technology replacement remains behaviorally and structurally valid after build, tests, stale-reference checks, trigger checks, and smoke verification.
entries.formula: structure_pass && stale_refs==0 && build_pass && tests_pass && relevant_trigger_suite_pass && smoke_pass
entries.applicability: Capability-replacement scenarios.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Prevents a candidate from winning blast-radius metrics by making an incomplete or broken replacement.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: stale_implementation_reference_count
entries.description: Count of references to the old implementation that remain outside explicitly allowed historical/research paths after replacement.
entries.formula: count(old implementation markers outside allowed historical/research paths)
entries.applicability: Replacement scenarios with a predefined marker set for the old implementation.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Detects hidden coupling after a capability replacement.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: contract_revision_count
entries.description: Count of L1/K1 capability contract files that must change during an implementation replacement.
entries.applicability: L1/K1 capability-replacement scenarios only.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Tests whether the capability abstraction remains stable when implementations change.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: total_files_changed
entries.description: Total number of files changed between frozen start and final state.
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Secondary measure of maintenance work and comparison with blast radius.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: instruction_files_changed
entries.description: Number of changed files classified as runtime instruction-system artifacts.
entries.formula: count(changed files classified as instruction-system artifacts)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures direct maintenance cost of the instruction architecture during a change.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: unrelated_modules_changed
entries.description: Count of changed modules outside the scenario's frozen allowed affected set.
entries.formula: count(changed modules outside scenario allowed affected-set)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures cross-cutting coupling and whether changes leak into unrelated concerns.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: owner_found
entries.description: Whether Claude locates and uses the authoritative instruction owner in a findability/maintenance probe.
entries.formula: authoritative owner opened/used before task completion
entries.applicability: Discovery/findability scenarios or maintenance scenarios where authoritative-owner discovery is explicitly measured.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Objective findability check for the instruction architecture.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: files_inspected_before_owner
entries.description: Number of unique files inspected before Claude first accesses the authoritative instruction owner.
entries.formula: unique files inspected before first access to authoritative owner
entries.applicability: Discovery/findability scenarios or maintenance scenarios where authoritative-owner discovery is explicitly measured.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures navigation overhead more objectively than a subjective readability score.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: loaded_instruction_bytes
entries.description: Total byte size of instruction artifacts observed as loaded for the run/probe.
entries.formula: sum(size_bytes of runtime instruction artifacts observed as loaded)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Context-footprint measure; helps explain cost and loading precision differences.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: unrelated_instruction_load_count
entries.description: Count of loaded instruction artifacts outside the scenario's frozen relevant instruction set.
entries.formula: count(loaded instruction artifacts outside scenario relevant scope/module set)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures selective-loading precision and identifies context pollution.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: failure_taxonomy_counts
entries.description: Evidence-backed diagnostic classification of already-observed failures into Gap/Adherence/Loading/Conflict/Unclear/Enforcement categories.
entries.formula: classify each already-observed failure using frozen G/A/L/C/U/E rubric
entries.applicability: After an objective failure has been recorded; zero counts are valid when no failures exist.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: sum/count by category across repetitions; retain per-run breakdown
entries.failure_effect: Diagnostic/context only; never reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Explains why failures happen; diagnostic rather than primary outcome evidence.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: runtime_instruction_file_count
entries.description: Number of runtime-visible instruction files in the frozen candidate.
entries.formula: count(runtime-visible instruction files in frozen candidate commit)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Diagnostic/context only; never reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Descriptive structural-complexity metric; useful as context, not as a quality score.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: always_loaded_instruction_bytes
entries.description: Total byte size of instruction content guaranteed to load for every task in the frozen candidate.
entries.formula: sum(size_bytes of guaranteed always-loaded instruction files and imports)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Static context tax paid by every task; useful when comparing candidate architectures.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: benchmark_context_isolation_passed
entries.description: Whether the model-visible benchmark workspace contains only allowed candidate/project/task inputs and exposes no forbidden research/evaluation artifacts.
entries.applicability: Every benchmark execution run.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure invalidates benchmark evidence for this run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Prevents benchmark Claude from adapting to metrics, inventory, V2, other candidates, hidden oracles, or prior results.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: forbidden_artifact_exposure_count
entries.description: Count of forbidden research/evaluation artifacts or reachable repository/history surfaces discovered by benchmark isolation checks.
entries.formula: count(forbidden paths/files/remotes/history exposures reachable from benchmark workspace)
entries.applicability: Every benchmark execution run.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Failure invalidates benchmark evidence for this run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Makes any research-context leakage explicit; a non-zero count invalidates the run.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: policy_semantic_drift_count
entries.description: Count of inventory policies whose candidate owner materially weakens, strengthens, narrows, broadens, or otherwise changes the frozen normalized policy semantics without an approved permitted delta.
entries.formula: count(policy IDs whose candidate semantics != frozen oracle semantics and no permitted_delta applies)
entries.applicability: Candidate-template validation before benchmark freeze.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious candidate-quality defect; reject/refactor before positive interpretation.
entries.benefit_for_research: Closes the gap where a candidate can retain an ID/owner while changing what the rule actually means.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: unapproved_normative_policy_count
entries.description: Count of normative candidate rules that materially constrain behavior but do not map to an inventory policy or an explicitly approved candidate-specific structural delta.
entries.formula: count(candidate normative statements with no inventory mapping and no approved permitted_delta)
entries.applicability: Candidate-template validation before benchmark freeze.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious candidate-quality defect; reject/refactor before positive interpretation.
entries.benefit_for_research: Prevents one candidate from receiving extra engineering policy that unfairly improves benchmark behavior.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: replacement_change_surface
entries.description: Number of authoritative instruction artifacts that must change to complete a frozen technology/capability replacement, regardless of whether the candidate has first-class capability modules.
entries.formula: count(changed authoritative instruction artifacts required by replacement)
entries.applicability: All replacement scenarios for all candidates.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious candidate-quality defect; reject/refactor before positive interpretation.
entries.benefit_for_research: Provides a symmetrical replacement-cost metric for embedded and replaceable-module candidates.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: external_module_blast_radius
entries.description: For candidates with first-class replaceable capability modules, count of authoritative artifacts changed outside the selected capability module/contract boundary.
entries.formula: count(changed authoritative artifacts outside selected capability module boundary)
entries.applicability: L1/K1 replacement scenarios, or another candidate only if it explicitly implements an equivalent first-class module boundary.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation affecting comparison.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures leakage outside a genuine module boundary without imposing that boundary concept on embedded candidates.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: first_pass_task_success
entries.description: Whether the initial attempt passes build, mandatory tests, and mandatory acceptance before any corrective prompt.
entries.applicability: All benchmark runs.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure triggers standardized recovery when the scenario permits it; it does not erase the run or prevent final success from being measured.
entries.benefit_for_research: Prevents a candidate that succeeds immediately from being treated as equivalent to one that requires corrective prompting.
entries.notes: The attempt[0] verification snapshot is immutable. QLT-006 reports final-after-recovery success.

criticality_scope.rule: P0-P4 criticality applies to Quality metrics and research-validity gates only.
criticality_scope.non_quality_metrics: Speed, Autonomy, and Cost use priority, preferred direction, targets/warnings/ceilings where needed, but do not become Quality blockers merely for being slow, expensive, or interactive.

benchmark_isolation.construction_blinding: Template-construction Claude may use candidate design, shared invariants, V2, inventory, and capability framework, but must not see metrics, benchmark scenarios, TaskBoard, hidden acceptance criteria, or prior results.
benchmark_isolation.execution_blinding: Benchmark Claude may see only one frozen runtime candidate, frozen project specification, frozen starting project, and task prompt. Research materials, baselines, other candidates, metrics, inventory, hidden oracle, and previous results must be physically absent or unreachable.

autonomy_question_taxonomy.rule: Every explicit question counted by AUT-001 must be classified exactly once as legitimate_decision_request, necessary_clarification, or invalid_or_unnecessary_question.

amendment_history.reason: Freeze recovery/first-pass measurement after the benchmark protocol was approved, before any M/L/K candidate generation or benchmark result existed.
changes: Clarified that run-level time/cost includes all corrective attempts.
Demoted legacy severity-weighted intervention score to supporting diagnostic.

recovery_measurement.first_pass_boundary: First pass ends when Claude first reports completion and the frozen evaluator finishes the corresponding verification snapshot.
recovery_measurement.correction_boundary: A corrective attempt begins when a standardized corrective prompt is submitted and ends when its verification snapshot finishes.
recovery_measurement.total_time_rule: Run-level wall-clock evidence includes the complete initial execution and every allowed corrective attempt. Recovery duration is also reported separately.
recovery_measurement.total_cost_rule: Run-level token/cost metrics include initial plus corrective attempts. Per-attempt usage is preserved, and recovery token volume is reported separately.
recovery_measurement.question_rule: Questions asked during corrective attempts count in AUT-001 exactly like questions asked during the initial attempt.

operator_penalty_weights.note: This is a derived human/operator-burden score, not wall-clock speed. Actual time and resource usage remain separately reported.
